title: Config
description: The file, as it is read. [`validate`](Config::validate) says whether the operator can work with it.

activity.description: Asking each agent what work it holds (AD-058 P2c).

defaults.description: What an agent gets when its config names nothing.

reconcile.description: The timers of a pass and the number of passes at once.

retention.description: What the operator keeps of a deleted agent's store (ANR-770).

runPods.description: The deployment's settings for run pods (slice D15a). Absent: this operator has no run pods.

telemetry.description: Traces (K5): the `telemetry.otlp` section, as the `OTEL_*` variables would say it.

version.description: 1. Required: a file of another shape is not read as this one.

AccessTierCap.description: The highest access tier a deployment lets a person pick (`access-tier/v1`).

oneOf.description: Also change files, commit, push and open pull requests.
Also merge pull requests and create repositories (the coder's default).
Also rename and delete repositories, with no consent form for a repository.

ActivitySection.description: `activity`: the HTTP activity source (AD-058 P2c), which asks each agent `GET /internal/activity` for the idle controller.

enabled.description:
Build the source. **Off by default**: no request is made. On, `token` is required, because the agents refuse a request
without their bearer.

timeoutSecs.description: How long one question may take, in seconds (1 to 30). An agent that does not answer by then counts as busy.

token.description: The bearer the agents accept, by reference (a mounted Secret key). Read once at start, never logged.

ContainerResources.description: The resources of a container the operator makes beside the agent's: the egress proxy's, the git sandbox's.

DefaultsSection.description: `defaults`: what an agent that names nothing gets.

agentImage.description: The image of an agent whose `AgentConfig` names none (AD-029): `repository:tag@sha256:…`.

agentRuntimeClass.description: The `RuntimeClass` of every agent's own pod (K14a, AD-052): the name of an object the cluster administrator made.

cacheAllowedClaims.description: The claims the deployment allows as an agent's package cache (K1). Empty: no agent may have one.

maxAccessTier.description: The highest access tier an `AgentConfig` may ask for (K1).

EgressProxySettings.description:
The egress proxy of the run pods of one agent (slice D15c; adam-rs ADR 0042, `runPods.egressProxy`): `adam-egress`, an
HTTPS-only forward proxy, from the agent's own coder image. It accepts `CONNECT host:port` to the hosts of the allow-list
and nothing else, resolves the name itself and connects to public IPv4 addresses only. The allow-list is the
**deployment's**: an `AgentConfig` cannot extend it (§60a, D15c, decision 1).

allow.description: The hosts a run pod may reach: `example.com` is that host, `.example.com` every subdomain of it and not the apex.

extraAllow.description: More hosts, added to `allow` (lower-cased, once each).

extraNoProxy.description: More names the tools reach without the proxy (`NO_PROXY`), after `localhost,127.0.0.1`.

ports.description: The ports a `CONNECT` may name, and the only TCP ports the proxy's pods may reach (443 is HTTPS).

replicas.description: Pods of the proxy, at least 1. With more than one, a PodDisruptionBudget keeps one up through a drain.

resources.description: CPU and memory of the proxy's container.

GitSandboxSettings.description:
The git sandbox of a coder with run pods (slice D15d; adam-rs ADR 0041, open decision 6, `runPods.gitSandbox` of the
coder chart): `adam-git-sandbox`, from **the agent's own coder image**, a native sidecar of the coder's pod in which the
coder's local `git` runs. A repository's configuration can name a program (a `filter.x.clean`, a `core.fsmonitor`) that
git runs, and some repositories are the run's own, so that program has to run where nothing secret is readable: the
sidecar has no Secret volume, no variable from a Secret, no service-account token (the token is a volume of the coder
container alone), a pid namespace of its own, a read-only root file system and a `/tmp` of its own. It mounts the work
volume at the same path as the coder and runs as the same user. It is on with run pods and has no switch.

maxCommands.description: `GIT_SANDBOX_MAX_COMMANDS`: git commands run at once, 1 to 4096; the next waits.

resources.description:
CPU and memory of the sidecar. The memory limit is required: a program that a filter starts is stopped by this limit
and not by the node's, and the sidecar's `/tmp` counts against it.

tmpSize.description:
The size of the sidecar's `/tmp`, in memory (`64Mi`): a program that fills it gets "no space left on device"; a
disk-backed volume would get the whole coder pod evicted.

enabled.description: Elect one replica to write. Off: this replica is the only one, and every pass writes.

leaseSecs.description: How long the lease lives, in seconds: a holder that has not renewed for this long may be replaced.

namespace.description: The namespace of the `Lease`. Absent: the primary namespace, the first of `watch.namespaces`.

renewSecs.description: How often the holder renews the lease, in seconds.

retrySecs.description: How often a replica that is not the holder tries, in seconds.

registry.description: Where the agent registry is served (only with a token).

filter.description: A `tracing` filter, such as `info,kube=warn,aap_controller=debug`. `info` when absent.

NodeTypeSettings.description:
The node types a run pod may be scheduled on (ANR-660, AD-066): the key of a node label the deployment keeps honest and the values
of it that it admits. The template is pinned to them by a required node affinity and the admission policy refuses a run pod that
is not. Both parts or neither.

labelKey.description: The node label's key (`example.com/node-type`). Empty: off.

OtlpSection.description:
The `telemetry.otlp` section of a configuration file (ANR-962, AD-064): the settings the `OTEL_*` variables carry,
written as YAML. Absent: tracing is off, exactly as with no variable.

The file names the headers by reference (a mounted file per header, or a variable) and the certificate by path; none
of them is read by [`validate`](Self::validate), which is what `--check` runs.

certificate.description: A PEM bundle that is the exporter's only trust, as a path.

endpoint.description: The full URL of the collector's traces endpoint (`https://collector:4318/v1/traces`). Absent or empty: off.

headers.description:
The headers the collector wants, by name: a token, usually. Each is read from its reference when the exporter is
built, and a header needs an `https` endpoint (a token in clear is a token given away).

resourceAttributes.description: The closed keys a deployment may add to the resource.

samplerRatio.description: The ratio of `traceidratio`, 0 to 1. Ignored by the other samplers.

timeout.description: How long an export may take, in milliseconds (the unit of `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TIMEOUT`). 10 000 by default.

concurrency.description: Services reconciled at the same time, per controller and per watched namespace. At least 1.

resyncPendingSecs.description: Seconds between looks at a service that is rolling out, unwell, or held by a foreign object.

resyncSecs.description: Seconds between looks at a service that is Ready or Suspended.

timeoutSecs.description: Seconds one pass over one object may take.

publicUrl.description: The URL of the registry document itself, sent as its `anchor`. Absent or empty: no `anchor`.

token.description:
The file (or variable) that holds the bearer token. **No token, no registry**: nothing is served on its port and
every service is `Listed: False`, reason `RegistryDisabled` (fail closed). Read once, at start.

RetentionSection.description: `retention`: what a deleted agent leaves behind.

afterDeleteDays.description:
Days the database and volumes of a deleted agent (`deletionPolicy: Retain`) are kept before they are deleted.
`0` keeps them for ever and turns the sweep off.

RunPodClass.description: One size class: the resources of the run container.

limits.description: What it may not exceed. `memory` is required: the quota counts it.

runtimeClassName.description:
The `RuntimeClass` of the pods of THIS class (ANR-402, AD-052): it replaces the deployment's `runtimeClassName` for them,
so one class can be sandboxed with another runtime handler than the rest, or sandboxed while the deployment names none.
Empty or absent: the deployment's, if it names one.

RunPodNetworkSettings.description:
What a run pod may reach, deny by default (adam-rs ADR 0042): no ingress; egress to DNS, to the egress proxy and to
`extraEgress`. There is no setting that opens the internet to a run pod, and none that turns the policy off: the
operator chart refuses `networkPolicy.enabled: false`, and a file that still has the key is refused here (an unknown key).

blockedCIDRs.description: Never reachable through the proxy: RFC 1918, the link-local range, the shared address space. IPv4.

clusterCIDRs.description: The pod and service CIDRs of the cluster, besides the ranges below: what the proxy never connects to. IPv4.

dnsPodLabels.description: The labels of the DNS pods.

extraEgress.description:
More egress rules for a run pod, as `NetworkPolicy` `egress` entries: `to` (an `ipBlock`, a `namespaceSelector` or a
`podSelector`) and `ports` (numbers). An in-cluster target the proxy cannot serve (it connects to public IPv4
addresses only), such as a model gateway: its host goes in `egressProxy.extraNoProxy` too.

RunPodQuotaSettings.description: The quota of one agent's run pods.

limitsMemory.description: A quantity (`8Gi`), counted on the limits of the pods.

RunPodSettings.description:
What the deployment says about run pods: the operator chart's `runPods` block, its `runPodClasses`, the
names of the cluster-scoped objects it made, as the `runPods` block of the operator's configuration file
(`bin/operator/README.md`). An
unknown key is refused. Everything the file does not default is required: the chart writes it all, so the
defaults are in one place.

A `RunPodSettings` is **checked** by [`validate`](Self::validate); the operator refuses to start with one
that fails, as it refuses a default image with white space in it.

classes.description: The size classes, by name (AD-031): the resources of the run container.

container.description: The container of the template the commands run in (`RUN_POD_CONTAINER`).

egressProxy.description: The one way out of a run pod to the internet (slice D15c; adam-rs ADR 0042).

extraAllowedImages.description:
Images a run pod may use besides the run image and the coder's own (the init container's), spelled as the
pod spells them.

extraEnv.description: More variables of the run container (never a secret).

gitSandbox.description:
The git sandbox of the coder's pod (slice D15d; adam-rs ADR 0041, open decision 6): the sidecar the coder's local git
runs in. There is no switch that turns it off while run pods are on.

idleSecs.description: Idle time before a pod is deleted (`RUN_POD_IDLE_SECS`); 0 keeps it until its run ends.

image.description: The run container's image: the workspace image of another-agentic-images.

networkPolicy.description: What a run pod may reach: names, the egress proxy and `extraEgress`, and nothing else.

nodeAffinity.description: `affinity.nodeAffinity` of the template, as written. Absent or `{}`: none.

nodeType.description:
The node types the deployment admits for run pods (ANR-660, AD-066). Empty (the default) is no restriction, and then the
field is not written, so no file, template or digest moves.

priorityClass.description:
The `PriorityClass` of run pods, which the quota is scoped to and the admission policy requires. The
chart made it (or the deployment manages it); the operator makes no cluster-scoped object.

quota.description: What the run pods of one agent may use in all.

readyTimeoutSecs.description: How long a pod may take to be ready (`RUN_POD_READY_TIMEOUT_SECS`).

role.description:
The `Role` that lets an account make, find, watch and delete pods and `exec` in them. The chart made it;
the operator binds each coder's account to it and holds the right to bind that role alone.

runtimeClassName.description:
The `RuntimeClass` of run pods (K14a, AD-052), when the deployment names one: the object is the administrator's,
and the admission policy requires this class once it is set. Empty or absent: none, and the template is what it was.

waitSecs.description: How long a run retries for a pod the cluster cannot give now (`RUN_POD_WAIT_SECS`).

SecretRef.description:
Where a value the configuration file does not hold is read from (ANR-962, AD-064): a mounted file, or a variable.

The file says `{ file: /var/run/secrets/aap/registry/token }` or `{ env: NAME }` and nothing else: one key, one text.
A value is never written in the file, and an error names the reference, never what it holds.

oneOf.description: A file, read once at start (a mounted Secret).

otlp.description: The OTLP/HTTP endpoint and what to send with it. Absent: no span is made.

enabled.description:
Probe the servers (`initialize` and `tools/list`) and write the reachability and tool names into the provider's
status. Off: no request is made and the status has no `Reachable` condition.

timeoutSecs.description: How long one probe may take, in seconds (1 to 60).

namespaces.description:
The namespaces to watch, in order: **the first is the primary**, which names the cluster-scoped objects of run
pods and the API's `defaults.namespace`. Empty: every namespace, which needs a `ClusterRole` the chart does not make.
